You look like a bunch of kids.|Rana Halion, ruler of Ieria, to members of the student mercenary squad of Andara|<ref name="Jedi Quest: The School of Fear">''[[Jedi Quest: The School of Fear]]''</ref>}}
'''Rana Halion''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Ierian]] who served as the ruler of the [[Ieria]] during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

A proponent of more equitably distributed [[Hyperspace route/Legends|trade routes]], Halion attempted to gain representation for her world, located in the greater [[Andaran system]]. Fighting for a seat in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], she argued that the planet [[Andara/Legends|Andara]] lessened Ieria's importance, and by giving her world a separate seat, her people could flourish.

Secretly, Halion hired a squad of rebellious mercenary students who'd found refuge within Andara's elite [[Leadership School]] to help rally people to her cause. The son of her opponent, [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Berm Tarturi]] of Andara—[[Gillam Tarturi]]—was leading the rebel group, however. When Gillam faked his own kidnapping as part of Halion's plot to assassinate the senator, the scheme went terribly awry. Only with the assistance of the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]], who sent two undercover "transfer students" to the school ([[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Ferus Olin]], with their [[Jedi Master/Legends|Masters]] lending support) to investigate Gillam's disappearance was the criminal attempt thwarted. The [[Mission to Andara|presence]] of the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] and their [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]], as they successfully infiltrated Halion's network of plotters, at last brought resolution to the Andaran conflict.

Halion was a tall, lanky humanoid with short white hair twisted into spikes. She possessed a commanding presence and had intense, penetrating clear blue eyes (so light, they were almost colorless). She wore gold cuffs that encircled her strong wrists.
